svg.text: Frontend Performance Architecture — LLD
Core Web Vitals & Rendering Pipeline
LCP (Largest Contentful Paint): <2.5 s — hero image, above-fold text
INP (Interaction to Next Paint): <200 ms — replaces FID in 2024
CLS (Cumulative Layout Shift): <0.1 — reserve space for images, fonts
Critical rendering path: HTML parse → CSSOM → Render tree → Layout → Paint
Render-blocking: inline critical CSS; defer/async non-critical scripts
LCP fix: preload hero image; use priority={true} in Next.js Image
INP fix: break long tasks (>50 ms) with scheduler.yield() / setTimeout(0)
CLS fix: width/height attributes on img; font-display: optional for web fonts
Bundle Optimization & Code Splitting
Tree shaking: ESM + side-effect-free packages; check package.json sideEffects
Code splitting: dynamic import() at route level — reduces initial bundle
Granular chunks: split vendor / framework / page / shared — cache each layer
Bundle analysis: webpack-bundle-analyzer / Next.js bundle analyzer
Import cost: avoid barrel imports (import * from 'lodash') — use lodash-es
Preload: link rel=modulepreload for next route's chunk on hover/idle
Compression: Brotli > gzip — 15-25% better; set on CDN and server
Target: initial JS <170 KB (gzip); per-route chunk <50 KB
Image, Font & Resource Optimization
Next-gen formats: WebP (30% smaller than JPEG), AVIF (50% smaller)
Responsive images: srcset + sizes — browser picks optimal resolution
Lazy loading: loading="lazy" for below-fold images; IntersectionObserver fallback
Blur placeholder: generate 8px blurred base64 during build; swap on load
Font subsetting: only include used glyph ranges via unicode-range descriptor
FOUT mitigation: font-display: swap + size-adjust to match fallback metrics
CDN: serve static assets from edge with far-future Cache-Control: max-age=31536000
HTTP/2 push → HTTP/3 QUIC: multiplexing eliminates head-of-line blocking
Runtime Performance & Measurement
Virtualization: render only visible rows (react-virtual) — not all 100k rows
Memoization: React.memo / useMemo / useCallback for expensive re-renders
Debounce/throttle: resize, scroll, input handlers — avoid per-frame work
Web Workers: move heavy computation (JSON parse, image processing) off main thread
requestAnimationFrame: batch DOM mutations; use for animations not setTimeout
Profiling: Chrome DevTools Performance tab → long tasks, layout thrash
RUM: web-vitals library → report to analytics; field data beats lab data
Performance budget: enforce in CI via Lighthouse CI with budget.json thresholds
LCP <2.5 s | INP <200 ms | CLS <0.1
Initial bundle <170 KB gzip; route chunks <50 KB
Break long tasks >50 ms with scheduler.yield()
AVIF/WebP + srcset; font-display: swap
RUM via web-vitals; enforce budget in CI
